title: Uniform Learning of Conservative Sensitivity Endpoints by Fixed-Architecture Conditional Estimators
banked_reason: D-0.5 proposal NO-PASS: the surviving source-specific audit remained below the field novelty floor, while the pivoted inference angle was observation-model obstructed and no distinct bounded repair remained.
gap_reasons: The stated central population correction is already established in banked scm_propensity_lv_sharpness_frontier, while the implementation target is ill-posed.
The matched pointwise rate and local Hoeffding interval are a direct standard reduction.

A single deliberately under-capacity, version-specific width-8 implementation counterexample is a useful audit but does not yet establish a general conditional-bound learning frontier, architecture-growth requirement, or calibrated repair.
With full treatment data and ignorability, the true propensity is identified from treatment assignments; without ignorability, the causal mean is already unidentified when corruption is zero.
proof_attempt_summary: Three revisions narrowed the classical contamination result into a pinned conditional-estimator audit and repaired the repository-overlap and clipping defects, but the surviving fixed-width counterexample remained source-specific and below field tier. A minimax unbounded-outcome pivot collapsed because ignorability identifies the propensity while dropping it already destroys causal identification; a field-scale continuation would require a new architecture-growth or calibrated post-fit theorem rather than another bounded revision.
tldr: Can the published pinned conditional estimator uniformly learn its own conservative KL outer endpoint with a fixed 8-unit dual architecture? On a smooth, overlapping Bernoulli causal submodel, the proposal predicts a fixed positive sup-norm error with probability tending to one: the true endpoint oscillates more often than the fitted dual-radius-plus-ridge score can. The argument concerns the actual default code path and leaves the population conservative bound valid; classical contamination and pointwise regression facts supply benchmarks.
gap: Jung--Kang analyze an exact empirical-minimizer estimator under correct-model and regularity assumptions, while the public fixed-width, fixed-epoch conditional path has no guarantee of uniform recovery. Classical pointwise Holder rates alone do not characterize this fitted output.
fill: Prove an optimizer-independent, version-pinned uniform inconsistency witness for the actual default reported endpoint, and isolate the architecture-growth or post-fit calibration condition that a positive guarantee would need.
